subject: Fireside chat invite: Serving LLMs in production (BrightPath Health) - June Summit
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fireside chat invite: Serving LLMs in production (BrightPath Health) - June Summit

Hi Jamie,

Hope you're well — it was great meeting you briefly at the HLTH webinar last month. We're running a small customer-focused track at the ConferenceX Summit in June (June 9-10) and I'd love to invite BrightPath to join a short fireside chat: 20 minutes, customer challenges -> solution -> measurable outcomes.

Why I thought of BrightPath: your team's work on triage automation and the low-latency requirements you mentioned could make a concrete story for other healthcare operators evaluating LLM inference in-prod. We can cover: integration timeline, reliability safeguards, and cost/perf tradeoffs.

Logistics (proposed):
- Format: fireside chat + 5-min audience Q&A
- Slot: morning of June 10 (flexible)
- Speaker: Jamie Carter (customer lead) + Redwood moderator (Marissa)
- Travel stipend + honorarium available; we also cover hotel nights for one person.

I've attached a short speaker brief and example agenda. Could you let me know if BrightPath would consider this and whether June 10 works roughly? If you'd prefer a recorded case-study instead, we can do that too.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com]
[Attachment: Redwood_Speaker_Brief.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

From: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fireside chat invite: Serving LLMs in production (BrightPath Health) - June Summit

Evelyn,

Thanks for the invite — appreciate you thinking of us. This sounds like a good fit for BrightPath, especially if we can highlight the production reliability work we did last quarter. June 10 should be fine at a high level, but I need to run it by our events/corp comms team (cc'ed below).

One quick question: would the session be recorded and if so, who owns the recorded asset? We have compliance constraints about patient-adjacent talk and need to sign off on materials.

I'll loop in our events lead and get back by early next week.

Best,
Jamie Carter
Head of Clinical Automation | BrightPath Health
[jamie.carter@brightpathhealth.com]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@brightpathhealth.com>, Anika Bose <anika.bose@conferencex.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fireside chat invite: Serving LLMs in production (BrightPath Health) - June Summit

Jamie — appreciate the quick reply. Thanks for flagging compliance — totally understand. Short answers: yes, the session will be recorded for post-event syndication but we can restrict distribution per your requirements; Redwood does not claim ownership of the raw asset without a signed release. We typically provide a cut for joint approval before wider use.

Anika — looping you in to confirm recording policy and the honorarium/hotel offer. Also, can ConferenceX provide a hold on a morning slot June 10 and send us logistics (A/V, remote fallback, NDA requirements)?

Marissa will be the Redwood moderator; Marissa, can you draft 3 bullets we want Jamie to highlight (timeline, SLA/latency lesson, cost delta after batching) and share the quick prep doc?

Thanks —
Evelyn

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fireside chat invite: Serving LLMs in production (BrightPath Health) - June Summit

Hi all,

Thanks for looping me in. ConferenceX can hold a 25-min morning slot on June 10 for the fireside chat. A few notes on policy/logistics: 

- Recording & assets: we record every session; host (ConferenceX) stores raw footage for 30 days. We can provide a link to the raw file for BrightPath to review and request redactions. Any joint marketing use requires a signed release; we have a one-page Media Release form we can send.
- A/V: in-person room will have projection + house mics; we also support a remote speaker via Zoom link. Please indicate if you need dedicated AV tech.
- Honorarium & travel: ConferenceX will process honorarium after session completion; Redwood can submit invoice for hotel stipend reimbursement.

I've attached the Media Release and a sample slot confirmation. Please confirm speaker name, title exactly as you'd like them on the agenda and whether you prefer in-person or remote.

Cheers,
Anika Bose
Partnerships Manager | ConferenceX
[Attachment: ConferenceX_Media_Release.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]

From: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Anika Bose <anika.bose@conferencex.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fireside chat invite: Serving LLMs in production (BrightPath Health) - June Summit

All — confirmed. BrightPath is happy to participate. Speaker will be Jamie Carter, Head of Clinical Automation (as listed). We'll be in person and will complete the ConferenceX Media Release this week.

Marissa: thanks for offering to moderate; can you share a brief prep call agenda and 30-minute slot windows that work for the week of May 18 for a rehearsal? We're flexible mornings PST.

Evelyn/Stephanie: if you could also send the talk bullets and any compliance checklist items you need from us (anonymized screenshots, approved talking points), we'll start prepping.

See you in June —
Jamie
